info.title: MDM API V4
info.description: Workspace ONE UEM MDM REST API V4

get.summary: New - Retrive profile details from Profile Id.
get.description:
Returns the full profile details, including all payloads associated with the profile.
The only payloads supported by this API are the Linux Wi-Fi, Credentials, and Custom Configuration payloads.

post.summary: New - Creates a v4 smart group.
post.description: Creates a new smart group rule under the given organization group, using a structured rule object instead of Criteria. The rule is always created under the organization group identified by the organization-group-uuid header. Returns the full created smart group rule.

400.description: Bad Request 1. {5005: Invalid input.} 2. {1027: Smart group rule name is required.} 3. {6184: Smart group rule with the same name already exists.} 4. {1026: The rule structure is malformed.} 5. {1063: Required header 'organization-group-uuid' is missing or invalid.}

401.description: Unauthorized 1. {5093: User does not have sufficient permissions to perform this operation.}

403.description: Forbidden 1. {5145: User does not have access to this organization group - {0}.}

404.description: NotFound 1. {6008: No organization group found for the given organization group UUID.}

422.description: Unprocessable Entity 1. {1012: name: The name field is required.} 2. {1012: rule: The rule structure could not be parsed.}

get.summary: New - Retrieves the smart group rule details.
get.description: Retrieves all the smart group rule details (name, uuid, organization group and rule structure) for the given smart group rule identifier.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the smart group rule.(Required).

400.description: Bad Request 1. {1063: Required header 'organization-group-uuid' is missing or invalid.}

401.description: Unauthorized 1. {5093: User does not have sufficient permissions to perform this operation.}

403.description: Forbidden 1. {5145: User does not have access to this organization group - {0}.}

404.description: NotFound 1. {8: Smart group rule not found for the given UUID or user does not have access to it.} 2. {6008: No organization group found for the given organization group UUID.}

put.summary: New - Replaces the details of the specified smart group rule.
put.description: Replaces the details of the specified smart group rule and returns the full updated smart group rule. The rule structure is fully replaced; it cannot be partially patched. A smart group rule cannot be moved to a different organization group (the organization-group-uuid header must match the rule's current organization group).

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the smart group rule.(Required).

parameters.name: smartGroupRuleRequest
parameters.description: The smart group rule details to be updated.(Required).

400.description: Bad Request 1. {5005: Invalid input.} 2. {6184: Smart group rule with the same name already exists.} 3. {1026: The rule structure is malformed.} 4. {1063: Required header 'organization-group-uuid' is missing or invalid.}

401.description: Unauthorized 1. {5093: User does not have sufficient permissions to perform this operation.}

403.description: Forbidden 1. {5145: User does not have access to this organization group - {0}.}

404.description: NotFound 1. {8: Smart group rule not found for the given UUID or user does not have access to it.} 2. {6008: No organization group found for the given organization group UUID.}

422.description: Unprocessable Entity 1. {1012: name: The name field is required.} 2. {1012: rule: The rule structure could not be parsed.}

delete.summary: New - Deletes the specified smart group rule.
delete.description: Deletes the smart group rule identified by the given smart group rule unique identifier.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the smart group rule.(Required).

400.description: Bad Request 1. {5005: Invalid input.} 2. {1063: Required header 'organization-group-uuid' is missing or invalid.}

401.description: Unauthorized 1. {5093: User does not have sufficient permissions to perform this operation.}

403.description: Forbidden 1. {5145: User does not have access to this organization group - {0}.} 2. {11: Cannot delete a smart group rule that is not a rule-expression smart group.}

404.description: NotFound 1. {8: Smart group rule not found for the given UUID or user does not have access to it.} 2. {6008: No organization group found for the given organization group UUID.}

409.description: Conflict 1. {This smart group rule has one or more dependencies. Unassign the smart group rule from its dependencies and try deleting again.}

get.summary: New - Lists the available values for a rule criterion, scoped to an organization group.
get.description: Returns the paged list of values that can be used in a rule condition for the given criterion, restricted to what is visible from the given organization group. USER_DISTINGUISHED_NAME is not supported, as it is free-text rather than a listable value.

parameters.name: criterion
parameters.description: The rule criterion to list available values for, scoped to the organization group.(Required).

parameters.name: request.page
parameters.description: Gets or sets the zero-based page number to retrieve.

parameters.name: request.pageSize
parameters.description: Gets or sets the number of results per page.

parameters.name: request.deviceType
parameters.description: Gets or sets the device platform to scope the returned values to, as supplied by the caller.

parameters.name: request.searchTerm
parameters.description: Gets or sets the term to narrow the returned values by, as supplied by the caller.

parameters.name: request.oem
parameters.description: Gets or sets the device manufacturer to scope the returned values to, as supplied by the caller.

parameters.name: request.enterpriseBrandName
parameters.description: Gets or sets the enterprise brand to scope the returned values to, as supplied by the caller.

400.description: Bad Request 1. {5005: Invalid input.} 2. {150114: The given criterion does not support listing values.} 3. {1063: Required header 'organization-group-uuid' is missing or invalid.} 4. {5005: Invalid device type.} 5. {5005: Search term is invalid.} 6. {5005: Invalid oem.} 7. {5005: Invalid enterprise brand name.}

401.description: Unauthorized 1. {5093: User does not have sufficient permissions to perform this operation.}

403.description: Forbidden 1. {5145: User does not have access to this organization group - {0}.}

404.description: NotFound 1. {6008: No organization group found for the given organization group UUID.}

SmartGroupRuleCreateRequestModel.description:
Request model to create a smart group rule. The owning organization group is taken from the
organization-group-uuid header and is therefore not part of the request body.

name.description: Name of the smart group rule. Must be unique within the organization group.

rule.description:
Versioned membership rule document (criteria-metadata contract version plus rule tree).
Optional; may be null. Version must be supplied by the caller — canonical does not default it.

RuleDocumentModel.description:
Versioned membership rule document. Matches smart-group-service RuleDocument:
criteria-metadata contract version plus the nested rule tree.

rule.description: Root membership rule node. A node may be a leaf condition or a nested grouping node.

RuleModel.description: A recursive rule node matching the smart-group-service Rule model.

criteria.description: The criteria for a leaf condition. Null for a grouping node.

value.description: The value for a leaf condition. Null for a grouping node.

operator.description: The comparison operator for a leaf condition. Null for a grouping node.

logical_operator.description: The logical operator for a grouping node. Null for a leaf condition.

rules.description: Nested rule nodes for a grouping node. Null for a leaf condition.

SmartGroupRuleResponseModel.description: Full details of a smart group rule.

name.description: Name of the smart group rule. Must be unique within the organization group.

rule.description: Versioned membership rule document returned from smart-group-service. Optional; may be null.

uuid.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the smart group rule.

tenant_uuid.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the tenant that owns this smart group rule.

customer_uuid.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the customer organization group that owns this smart group rule.

managed_by_organization_group_uuid.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the organization group that manages this smart group rule.

created_at.description: The date and time in UTC when the smart group rule was created.

created_by.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the user who created the smart group rule.

updated_at.description: The date and time in UTC when the smart group rule was last updated.

updated_by.description: The unique identifier (uuid) of the user who last updated the smart group rule.

name.description: The human-readable display name for the value.
